<function name="StopLoopingSound" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Stops a sound created by <page>Entity:StartLoopingSound</page>.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="id" type="number">The sound ID returned by <page>Entity:StartLoopingSound</page></arg>
	</args>
</function>
